baseline.mutationModel:
model MenuCatalogMutation {
  venueId          String
  mutationId       String
  entityType       MenuEntityKind
  entityId         String
  operation        String
  expectedRevision Int
  resultRevision   Int
  seq              Int
  actorType        MenuMutationActor
  actorId          String
  source           String
  /// SHA-256 of the normalized request; a reused id with other content is refused.
  requestHash      String
  /// Field-level before/after of what changed; never a whole catalog snapshot.
  changes          Json
  /// REAPPLY when an operator re-applied a change after an explicit conflict.
  resolution       String?
  createdAt        DateTime          @default(now())
  venue            Venue             @relation(fields: [venueId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([venueId, mutationId])
  @@index([venueId, entityId])
  @@index([venueId, createdAt])
  @@schema("pos")
}

contract.businessOutcome: Semantically identical on exact retry; duplicate describes delivery and becomes true; JSONB key order is not a wire contract.

contract.failures: Conflicts, input/policy/auth failures and transient/aborted transactions are not persisted terminal results.
contract.retention: No pruning; MENU-10 owns retry horizon / retention floor.
